images.name: k8s
images.pulledBy: The chart's pre-delete cleanup hook Job.
images.description: alpine/k8s — kubectl plus a shell, for the hook that deletes the PlatformAgent CR before Helm removes the operator. The name is the trailing path segment because the chart renders this one: kube-agents.imageRepository rewrites onto <prefix>/<trailing name>, which has to be the destination mirror_images.sh writes (<prefix>/<name>).

images.name: hindsight-api
images.pulledBy: The chart, when the memory provider uses Hindsight (make deploy-hindsight for the kustomize dev path).
images.description: Serves the agents' long-term memory. Pinned by digest as well as tag; a mirrored install pulls the copy by tag, because that is what 'make mirror-images' pushes.

images.name: hindsight-postgresql
images.pulledBy: The chart, alongside the Hindsight API.
images.description: Postgres with the pgvector extension, the store behind the Hindsight API. The pg15 line, not a newer one: the StatefulSet keeps its data on a PVC, and Postgres refuses a data directory written by another major, so moving off pg15 is a pg_upgrade rather than a tag change. Postgres 15 is supported upstream until November 2027, though Hindsight's own floor is Postgres 15 too, so this sits at the oldest major it supports and a release that raises that floor forces the pg_upgrade sooner. Upstream also rebuilds a version tag in place when the Postgres base is patched, which is what the digest half of the pin holds still.
